aqueduct.abilityText:
When you gain a Treasure, move 1VP from its pile to this. When you gain a Victory card, take the VP from this.
Setup: Put 8VP on the Silver and Gold piles.

arena.abilityText:
At the start of your Buy phase, you may discard an Action card. If you do, take 2VP from here.
Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

basilica.abilityText:
When you gain a card in your Buy phase, if you have $2 or more, take 2VP from here.
Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

bandit-fort.abilityText: When scoring, -2VP for each Silver and each Gold you have.

battlefield.abilityText:
When you gain a Victory card, take 2VP from here.
Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

baths.abilityText:
When you end your turn without having gained a card, take 2VP from here.
Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

colonnade.abilityText:
When you gain an Action card in your Buy phase, if you have a copy of it in play, take 2VP from here.
Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

defiled-shrine.abilityText:
When you gain an Action, move 1VP from its pile to this. When you gain a Curse in your Buy phase, take the VP from this.
Setup: Put 2VP on each non-Gathering Action Supply pile.

fountain.abilityText: When scoring, 15VP if you have at least 10 Coppers.

keep.abilityText: When scoring, 5VP per differently named Treasure you have, that you have more copies of than each other player, or tied for most.

labyrinth.abilityText:
When you gain a 2nd card in one of your turns, take 2VP from here.
Setup: Put 6VP here per player.

mountain-pass.abilityText: When you are the first player to gain a Province, each player bids once, up to 40D, ending with you. High bidder gets +8VP and takes the D they bid.

museum.abilityText: When scoring, 2VP per differently named card you have.

orchard.abilityText: When scoring, 4VP per differently named Action card you have 3 or more copies of.

palace.abilityText: When scoring, 3VP per set you have of Copper - Silver - Gold.
